description: Find restriction sites for named enzymes (any of the 754 REBASE enzymes with a defined cut, case-insensitive) on both strands of a DNA sequence; 0-based forward-strand coordinates, per-strand cut positions, linear cut-feasibility filter or circular origin-spanning search.

sequence.description: DNA sequence to scan. IUPAC ambiguity codes are accepted anywhere in the sequence (N, R, Y, ...), so an N-containing contig or a soft-masked assembly can be scanned as it is: a site N matches any of the 15 IUPAC codes, every other site code matches only a concrete A/C/G/T base it expands to, and a character outside the 15 codes matches nothing — Biopython's own rule. Lower case is accepted; the returned fragment and site sequences are upper-case (the soft mask is not carried over; positions and lengths are unaffected).

enzyme_names.description: Names of restriction enzymes to look for.

topology.description: Linear (default) or Circular: whether the molecule is a linear fragment or a closed circle (plasmid).

methylation.description: Optional methylation-aware recognition (EMBOSS restrict -methylation semantics): "none" (default), "dam" (GmATC), "dcm" (mCmCAGG, mCmCTGG), "dam+dcm" or "emboss" (all five Emethylsites.dat entries incl. EcoKI). Case-insensitive. A recognition window containing a methylated base is NOT a site (a window rule, not an enzyme-specific sensitivity table; BamHI is blocked by Dam).

position.description: 0-based forward-strand start of the recognition window.

cutPositionForward.description: Cut offset on the forward strand (Biopython fst5).

cutPositionReverse.description: Cut offset on the reverse strand (Biopython size + fst3).

secondCutForward.description: Two-sided (Type IIB) cutters only: top-strand offset of the second cut pair (Biopython scd5; BaeI 23). Omitted/null for a one-cut enzyme.

secondCutReverse.description: Two-sided (Type IIB) cutters only: bottom-strand offset of the second cut pair (Biopython size + scd3; BaeI 18). Omitted/null for a one-cut enzyme.

isBluntEnd.description: True when both strands are cut at the same offset (Biopython is_blunt).

overhangType.description: End chemistry: the sign of Biopython ovhg.

recognitionLength.description: Length of the full recognition string (Biopython size); SfiI is 13.

rebaseMethylationField.description: REBASE allenz.104 field <6> (METHYLATION SITE) verbatim, e.g. "3(6)" for EcoRI; "" when REBASE records none. The site the enzyme's COGNATE methyltransferase modifies, not Dam/Dcm/CpG sensitivity.

position.description: 1-based position of the modified base in the recognition sequence, counted from the 5' end of the named strand; null for REBASE '?'.

isComplementaryStrand.description: True for a REBASE negative position (complementary strand).

enzyme.description: The enzyme record (same shape as the items of enzymes_by_cut_length).

isForwardStrand.description: True when the window reads as the site on the forward strand; false for a reverse-strand reading.

cutPosition.description: Top-strand cut for a forward record; the bottom-strand cut (forward-strand coordinate) for a reverse record. Circular molecules: reduced modulo the length.

recognizedSequence.description: The window as read on the strand that carries the site (upper-case).

isSecondCut.description: True on the second record of a two-sided (Type IIB) enzyme, whose one site is cleaved on both sides (BaeI, BcgI, ...): the flag is the only way to tell the two records of one site apart. False for every other record.

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
At least one enzyme name is required
Unknown methylation set '{name}'; expected none, dam, dcm, dam+dcm or emboss.
The topology must be MoleculeTopology.Linear or MoleculeTopology.Circular.
